question: In February 2022 , which state government passed an ordinance to amend its Lokayukta Act 1999 , according to which the state government would have the power to "either accept or reject the verdict of the Lokayukta after an opportunity of being heard"?
solution:
The correct answer is **"Kerala".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan** and **Kerala Governor Arif Mohammed Khan** gave their assent for the debatable ordinance to amend the Kerala **Lokayukta Act 1999**. 
 
• With this amendment, the kingdom authorities could have the energy to** “both take delivery of or reject the decision of the Lokayukta after a possibility of being heard”.** 
 
• Currently, beneath neath **Section 14** of the Act, a public servant is needed to vacate the workplace if directed with the aid of using the Lokayukta.
 
• The modification has taken away this obligatory nature of the verdicts with the aid of using the **quasi-judicial anti-corruption** body.
 
• Post-amendment, a **Lokayukta verdict** could have the most effective recommendatory jurisdiction, now no longer an obligatory one. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Kerala:

 
 
• Chief Minister - Pinarayi Vijayan.
 
• Governor - Arif Mohammad Khan.
 
• Capital: Thiruvananthapuram
 
• Number of Districts - 14.
 
• Lok Sabha seats - 20.
 
• Rajya Sabha seats - 9.
 
• State Animal - Indian elephant.
 
• State Bird - Great hornbill.
 
• National Park: Anamudi Shola National Park, Eravikulam National Park, Mathikettan Shola National Park, Pambadum Shola National Park, Periyar National Park 1982, Silent Valley National Park.
 
• Dams: Idukki Dam (Periyar river), Mullaperiyar masonry gravity dam (Periyar rive), Pazhassi Dam or Kulur Barrage (Valapattanam river).
 
• Registered GI: Aranmula Kannadi, Palakkadan Matta Rice, Balaramapuram Saris and Fine Cotton Fabrics.
